notes.title: v1.2.0.6 Update + An Apology
notes.notes: [p]Hey y'all, I noticed an influx of negative reviews recently so I made a small update to fix some bugs/issues as well as adding some new content to the game. I didn’t fix everything that I saw when reading through the negative reviews, just everything I felt like was necessary to address asap.[/p][p]This was going to be a slightly larger update, I did make a few new cards:[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622028/f3368bb6b939a55fb53272a9d083de8521193cbe.png"][/img][/p][p]And a new shopkeeper:[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622028/174aff52c8081671785fd01bdd01fb2ff9229154.png"][/img][/p][p]…But I’ve decided to scrap all that for now. I’m having a hard time finding motivation to add these into the game at the moment. Maybe in a later update.[/p][p][b]v1.2.0.6 Update Changelog[/b][/p][list][*][p]added new relics[/p][/*][*][p]added new banners[/p][list][*][p]the new banners are from art fight attacks, ft. art from rabbitlegs, theargonninja, kafeiketon, slirth, cactuscompanion, ezikk, and flameblaze[/p][/*][*][p]big gold chests will now always contain these, everything that was in them previously now appears in the green chests[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]added new starter deck (Lesha)[/p][list][*][p]Lesha starts off with randomized cards, and no card traders will spawn[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]you can now reroll lesha’s shop with star tickets[/p][/*][*][p]card stats now display below troop when hovering on field[/p][/*][*][p]reworked unit pathfinding[/p][/*][*][p]added option to skip battles in exchange for star tickets[/p][list][*][p]the button will appear if your average card level is higher than your opponent’s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]removed alternate opponent AIs that were added in the previous update[/p][list][*][p]this was originally added as a way to make the opponent AIs more interesting, but they were not working correctly (i.e. just not placing down cards at all)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]adjusted difficulty scaling[/p][list][*][p]increased upgrades per floor, energy multipliers, and max energy for secundus onwards[/p][/*][*][p]omicron’s cards now have a base level of 5 instead of 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]other minor bug fixes and visual improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622028/38f8340a0ff18854907a34e7a42dc31f156e9891.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Alongside this update post I have a few words I'd like to say.[/p][p]I'd like to apologize. For a few things, really. First, I apologize for not having something like this out sooner. I've been juggling a lot of projects recently, so putting out updates for this game hasn't been super high on my priority list. Plus I haven't had as much time to work on game dev lately, as well as having some slight burnout.[/p][p]I'd also like to apologize for... I guess failing you all? I feel like since there's a lot of negativity surrounding this game a lot of people are disappointed by it. Some people have said that it "feels unfinished" or it's "sloppy". There's also people unhappy with the split screen thing, the difficulty, the writing, the characters, the gameplay, everything. To me it seems like a lot of people just don't like this game, and were expecting something better.[/p][p]I'm not perfect, and nothing I make ever will be. Despite that, I always try to pour my heart and soul into what I make and hope people will enjoy it. And... maybe that's not enough? Maybe I shouldn't have made this game in the first place. Maybe people are more happy with the pay-to-win garbage that Supercell and it's copycats have been churning out. Maybe I shouldn't have made a game that's a product of my own tastes and should've gone for something more generic. Maybe then people would've been happier. I dunno.[/p][p]I know Aestheta is just a small $3 game, but it's also my creation. It's an extension of myself, and an insult to the game is an insult to me. I take all the negative reviews seriously, and since there's been so many I feel like a failure. Even if I fix everything that's wrong with the game it's not going to magically lead to a more positive reception, all I can really hope is that it makes it slightly less worse.[/p][p]So... I'm sorry. Really, I am. Not exaggerating or anything. I feel genuinely guilty for not making something better for you all. My heart aches and I feel like shit. I hope you can forgive me, and I'll try to do better in the future.[/p][p]I'm certain there's going to be people calling me cringe for opening up and sharing my feelings, and that's okay. I don't expect anyone to take this seriously, I just wanted to be transparent with how I feel as the developer.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who cares about this game and wants to see it grow and develop into something better, I truly appreciate your support. It means a lot.[/p][p]If you have any feedback or bug reports, [b]please DM them to me on discord (@aplove) or bluesky (aplovestudio.bsky.social)[/b] and I'll try to get back to you asap. If you leave them in the steam discussions or in a negative review, I most likely won't see it.[/p]

notes.title: Aestheta v1.2 Update + Final Devlog Video
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! Over the past week or so I've been cooking up some new content for the game, as well as making some changes to improve the overall quality of the game. The v1.2 Update is now available![/p][h3]Aestheta Devlog #2[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EKnKW3kpc3k"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Along with this update, I made another YouTube devlog where I discuss the new changes as well as addressing issues players have had with the game. This is probably my final devlog for Aestheta, I currently do not have any major plans for the future of this game. It's about 15 minutes long, in case you wanted something to listen to as background noise later.[/p][h3]New Cards[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622028/b8e0cb320f75d6db12d67c533bdba04da995277f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622028/6610f86c9f04f8e5a14e75a9673e7ce3497516f3.png"][/img][/p][p]New cards!! I've added some new cards you can trade for as well as some new Champions. Two of the new Champions were existing cards that have each been condensed into one card.[/p][h3]Double Duel Mode[/h3][p]I added 2v2 to the game! This will appear as a rare battle mode where you and a teammate face off against two opponents at once![/p][h3]Changes to Relics[/h3][p]Relics can stack now, basically. Some relics have also been changed to be more engaging as well as having effects that can stack.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing Aestheta! [b]If you have any bugs or issues, feel free to send me a DM on Discord (@aplove)[/b] and I'll try to have it fixed asap. Cheers![/p][p][/p][p]v1.2 update changelog:[/p][list][*][p]added new cards[/p][list][*][p]Hermit Crab, Jellyfish, Whirlpool, Pirate Crew, Treads, Missile Launcher, Broken Mirror, Superposition, Stigma, Taffy[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]condensed some existing cards into Champions[/p][list][*][p]Blightriders & Chainsoul, Carissa & Aqua are now each one card[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]added 2v2 gamemode[/p][/*][*][p]added new challenges[/p][/*][*][p]added new relics[/p][list][*][p]joker, jack-o-lantern, mimic, D20[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]reworked existing relics[/p][list][*][p]relic effects can now stack[/p][/*][*][p]changed some relics to be more engaging (i.e. solace beacon now heals champions instead of reducing spawn time)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]fixed champion abilities also applying to enemy champions[/p][/*][*][p]opponents will sometimes have traded cards in later battles[/p][/*][*][p]decreased card level increase from +20% per level to +10% per level[/p][/*][*][p]added new tab icons to main menu[/p][/*][*][p]star ticket run limit now increases per loop[/p][/*][*][p]added relics to card glossary tab[/p][/*][*][p]added card & relic descriptions to star ticket shop[/p][/*][*][p]added card type (troop, spell, building) to main deck tab[/p][/*][*][p]added simple tutorial text at the start of the game[/p][/*][*][p]flying troops now appear much higher and have a different visual around their shadows[/p][/*][*][p]updated disclaimer[/p][/*][*][p]fixed card borders button not appearing properly and being unable to assign card borders[/p][/*][*][p]balance changes[/p][list][*][p]nekomancer now summons skeletons in front of them[/p][/*][*][p]spikeball deals knockback[/p][/*][*][p]abomination deals way less damage[/p][/*][*][p]seraphim has more health[/p][/*][*][p]devourer now takes damage over time[/p][/*][*][p]other minor stat changes[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]minor visual adjustments[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0.5 patch
notes.notes: [p]tiny patch with mostly visual adjustments[/p][p]- added damage radius for spells and troops with spawn damage[/p][p]- added troop level underneath name when placing card + name now adjusts with character height[/p][p]- fixed vanishing cards like ghost girl causing troops to not target anything[/p][p]- minor visual tweaks and balance changes[/p]

notes.title: v1.1.0.4 patch
notes.notes: [p]mostly quality of life changes based on feedback, i've seen a few people mention how the horizontal split screen layout is a little bit disorienting, so i've added in an option to display the game in the vertical layout like the mobile version in case anyone is interested in trying that out (it was originally a secret option i added in for testing purposes and accidentally left it in, it's an actual option now)[/p][p][/p][p]- fixed crash from clown[/p][p]- fixed helltower not targeting air units[/p][p]- fixed typos[/p][p]- towers now display how much hp they have[/p][p]- moved banner select from the options tab to the chest tab[/p][p]- added card descriptions displaying by hovering over cards in card trading[/p][p]- added option to display game in vertical mode[/p][p]- fixed music option doing nothing[/p][p]- fixed troops like mime going outside of the arena[/p][p]- minor adjustments and balance changes[/p]
